title: “Where Are We? A Battle? Oh No!”
front_description: Hapless Threepio, his head atop a battle droid's body, is forced to march into the arena conflict with the rest of the troops. "I'm just a droid. I'm not made for this!" he frantically protests. Jedi Kit Fisto uses the to knock this half-friend, half-foe backward onto the arena floor. Again it's R2-D2 to the rescue, attaching a projectile to Threepio's head and pulling it free from the battle droid body.
back_description: Doug Chiang's early design of a super battle droid.
